2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __to the subscriber on a display device associated with the subscriber's receiver__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __based on subscription tier or service package information specific to the subscriber__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber __directly from the subscriber's receiver or set-top terminal__ from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __wherein the list is stored locally at the subscriber's receiver__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information __retrieved from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __before the filtered EPG information is displayed to the subscriber__.

6. (Original) The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider.

7. (Currently amended) An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider __at a time after the subscriber has subscribed to services from the content delivery provider__; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber __based on the subscriber's current subscription status__, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider.

8. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a user interface of a set-top box or receiver device__.

9. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __from subscription information maintained by the content delivery provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

10. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber __including service tier and package details__ from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information __and storing the list in local memory of the machine__.

11. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information __as received from the EPG provider__; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __prior to presentation to the subscriber__.

14. (Currently amended) The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to display the filtered EPG information __on a screen or display associated with a subscriber's receiver or set-top terminal__.
